2026-W47: A library people and their agents could use

The opening weekend established the learning experience. A visitor could finish SE 101, listen to a book preview and bring an assistant to read the same material. The contribution and copy paths opened the work to other builders.
2026-W48: Learning moved from individual tasks toward operating systems

The enterprise capstone and the completed SE 201 sequence linked the individual engineering loop to team operation. SE 301 carried that progression onto learners’ own hardware. The proposed SE 401 cohort gave it a prospective real-world problem, while optional sign-in made longer study easier to resume.

2026-11: An open engineering school takes shape

November established two connected ways to learn. The courses teach and demonstrate engineering practice, while the OpenBook tells the stories behind it and invites outside experience. A reader can use the public material, copy the project, and now save progress to an account. The local-compute playbook and proposed community cohort describe where that foundation could lead.
